product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker helps critical-infrastructure asset owners and operators plan, build, operate, and maintain projects, sites, and assets through a centralized asset-lifecycle-management platform.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies asset owners and operators as the audience and describes centralized management from planning and development through construction, operations, maintenance, and asset management: https://www.sitetracker.com/.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage offers a demo rather than a pricing link: https://www.sitetracker.com/. The pricing profile reports that /pricing returns 404 and no pricing, plans, or packaging page appears in the sitemap: https://apis.io/plans/sitetracker/sitetracker-plans-pricing. The negative assessment partly relies on that independent site inventory.

founded_year.notes: Sitetracker’s company profile explicitly lists its founding year as 2013: https://linkedin.com/company/10379201.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index presents industry, product, and operational-advice articles rather than two engineer-authored accounts of how Sitetracker is built: https://www.sitetracker.com/resources/blog. This negative assessment is limited to the available index.

public_docs.notes: The reviewed homepage did not expose public documentation or help links: https://www.sitetracker.com/. The API profile explicitly reports that documentation is behind a Salesforce Community login, with no public developer portal or API reference: https://apis.io/providers/sitetracker. The negative conclusion partly relies on this independent inventory.
